domains.name: 英雄域
singleSourceRules: CharacterCatalog owns playable character identity
ProfessionCatalog owns profession combat base data
ProfessionSkillCatalog owns profession skill modules
ProfessionSkillRunState owns in-run skill levels
EquipmentLoadoutService owns hero equipment combat modifiers
HeroSkillRuntime consumes CombatEventBus/EnemyStatusSystem instead of owning enemy state
HeroRunStatState owns in-run attack, defense, max-HP, move-speed and dodge growth levels
HeroRunUpgradeService is the only mixed skill/stat three-choice entry
MainHeroController is the only player movement runtime
CompanionBattleController owns AI global targeting, chase and walk-back behavior using CharacterCombatant moveSpeed

domains.name: 战斗域
singleSourceRules: EnemyController owns enemy life, movement, attack and death facts
CombatEventBus only publishes completed combat facts
EnemyStatusSystem owns enemy slow, stun, freeze, taunt and hunter mark state
BattleTargetRegistry owns live hero target registration and lookup
DefenseObjectiveService/CoreHealth owns revive channels and tower-HP revive cost for all heroes

domains.name: 经济域
singleSourceRules: CurrencyService owns coin and gem balances
ShopCatalog owns deterministic shop offer definitions
ShopService owns daily purchase limits, payment validation and inventory delivery
Shop UI only reads snapshots and emits purchase intents

domains.name: 界面域
singleSourceRules: BattleHudLayout owns battle-screen visibleSize/SafeArea coordinate conversion
HUD reads runtime state and does not own combat state
BattleWorld scaling remains in BattleWorldService and is not duplicated by HUD layout
MainMenuView exclusively switches the five independent MainMenu pages and owns the persistent shared MainMenuBottomNav
MainMenuShopPage preserves the shared bottom navigation; shop business state remains in Economy/Storage/Stamina services
MainMenuFullscreenShell owns the shared full-screen chrome and 132px navigation-safe boundary for Hero, Warehouse and Upgrade pages
